Business implementation classes should be internal by default.

What the Standard says

“Class Visibility and Exposure Control” — Implementations should expose only the contracts consumers require. Restricting implementation visibility keeps callers coupled to local interfaces and prevents accidental use of concrete business components. read it here.

Why it matters

Business implementations are internal details; consumers should see their contracts and composition roots instead. Restricting visibility reduces accidental coupling to concrete classes and preserves the freedom to change an implementation without expanding the public API.

Bad code example

// Violates STX0006: Business implementation classes should be internal by default.
public class StudentProcessingService(IStudentService students) : IStudentProcessingService { }

Good code example

// Follows STX0006
internal class StudentProcessingService(IStudentService students) : IStudentProcessingService { }
